events.title: Xbow Raises $120 Million, Hits $1 Billion Valuation in AI Cybersecurity Push
events.body: DFJ Growth and Northzone lead funding round as startup scales AI tools to detect software vulnerabilities amid rising cyber threats.

events.title: Digital investment platform Scalable Capital lands $175m funding
events.body: Existing investors Balderton Capital, Tencent, and HV Capital joined the funding round, raising its total investment to over $535m.
